notes.title: Forsaken Fortress Strategy v1.13 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Publisher here: just to confirm the most recent update's patch notes are below.

1. Lowered the difficulty. (more resources and less difficult enemies)
2. More beginner friendly. Some regions can enter with only melee weapons.
3. Temperature is now a personal attribute. You need to maintain your survivors' body temperature to avoid sickness.
4. More adjustments on maps.
5. The original pre-built base building is back.

notes.title: Patch V1.11 released!
notes.notes:
We just released v1.11
v1.1x version has some major changes over the v1.0x. For instance, much bigger maps(allows you to explore more and engage in some more strategic long-range combats)

Release Notes, 
-Enlarged maps
-Construct buildings(you start with almost nothing and have to build from scratch)
-Some UI improvements
-Minor balance changes
-Item conditions
-More loots
-Looting weapons from dead enemy
-Enhanced base raiders
-More dynamic enemy encounters

We will keep working on this game. Our next patch will include more base items to build, for instance, mines, traps and maybe things for entertainment.
If you have any suggestions, please drop a line. 
Please keep following us and we will push this game to its best.

Thanks

notes.title: Bug fix Patch v1.01
notes.notes:
We just released a new patch. Version v1.01

Patch Notes:
1. Fixed camera spinning (It is a hard bug since we are not sure the nature of the spin. We tried something and hopefully it works, if not we will continue to work on this one)

2. Increased the population cap from 3 to 6.

3. Fixed some pathfinding errors.

4. Added an option menu for graphic and language.

We are still collecting bugs and suggestions on our bug feedback thread here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/344820/discussions/0/490121928356654717/
